entries.name: Edward Bromberg

expected.convicted: Convicted; judgment reversed by the U.S. Supreme Court on April 26, 1965 (Thomas v. Mississippi, 380 U.S. 524).
expected.sentence: Municipal court imposed a suspended 60-day sentence and a $200 fine; the county-court retrial imposed four months and a $200 fine. These are sentences, not verified time served. The U.S. Supreme Court reversed the conviction on April 26, 1965. Individual custody endpoints remain separately documented or unresolved.

entries.rationale: The joint appeal printed page 23 individually dates Bromberg arrest to June 9, 1961 at 5:30 a.m.; page 9 confirms petitioners were arrested and jailed. This matches the archival booking photograph date. Printed page 7 groups him with June 20 arrests, but the individualized account and independent archival record resolve the initial date as June 9. Original printed page 23 scan inspected. Release remains unknown; existing reversal and sentencing details preserved.
